Zoe: quick FYI - partner onboarding hit a snag: samples and quickstarts use different env names for the API key and CI broke after rotation.
Chris: ugh, again. which names?
Zoe: found `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, `RW_TOKEN`, and `REDWOOD_KEY` across repos. example: `examples/chat/README.md` uses RW_TOKEN, `docs/quickstart.md` uses REDWOOD_API_KEY, `examples/python/search.py` sets REDWOOD_KEY in code.
Priya: we should pick one canonical name and support a file variant. Proposal: REDWOOD_API_KEY (string) + REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE (path). Also canonical short scoping vars: REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT.
Chris: agree. Also SDK behavior must be consistent on auth failures. Node right now throws Error, python raises AuthException with different fields. That breaks caller retry logic.
Zoe: actionables?
Priya: small plan: 1) standardize env var names in docs/samples 2) add env-normalizer helper in SDKs (node/python first) that reads canonical + aliases and emits a single-line migration hint when legacy vars detected 3) SDK parity: add tokenProvider(fn) to all SDKs and normalize AuthError shape.
Chris: for env-normalizer I suggest precedence: REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE > REDWOOD_API_KEY > legacy aliases. In CI mode (REDWOOD_CI=true) treat conflicting sources as an error. 
Zoe: CLI should also change `rw auth login` to output JSON by default: `{"token":"...","expiry":"..."}` and a shell snippet for bash/pwsh/fish. Make default ephemeral short-lived (15m) unless `--service-principal` passed.
Priya: yes. Also add REDWOOD_CREDENTIALS_FILE for org-issued JSON envelopes: {"token":"..","expiry":"..","project":".."}. SDKs read that if present.
Chris: error normalization idea: AuthError {message, code, retryable}. Map 401/403 -> retryable=false, 429 -> retryable=true. Make this consistent across SDKs.
Zoe: small DX: when legacy env seen, print: "Found RW_TOKEN; consider REDWOOD_API_KEY. See https://rwd.co/migrate-keys". Allow opt-out with REDWOOD_SILENCE_ENV_WARN=true.
ops-bot: reminder: scheduled key rotation for org "test-partner" on 2026-06-21T04:00:00Z. Contact security for exemptions.
security: noted - we'll coordinate if partners need a freeze window.
Priya: I'll build the node/python env-normalizer lib and add tests. Chris: can you file the Go SDK parity issue for tokenProvider + AuthError?
Chris: yep, I'll open issues and add to the SDK parity board.
Zoe: I'll grep repos and open PRs to replace legacy vars in samples and add shell variations for quickstart.
Priya: checklist for whoever picks this up:
- standardize canonical env vars in docs/samples (REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE, REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT)
- env-normalizer helper + single-line migration hints in SDKs
- CLI: JSON output + shell snippets + ephemeral default + service principal flow
- SDK parity: tokenProvider hook + normalized AuthError shape across languages
- migration doc mapping legacy names -> canonical and examples for Bash/PowerShell/fish
Zoe: adding @devex and @security. Will post PR links here. :thumbsup:
